_comment: Frozen while a reviewer holds them. Remove an entry when the review returns; an empty list is the normal state. `unchanged_since` is the commit the declaration pins: no commit after it may touch the path. HEAD itself is NEVER pinned -- committing the review prompt moves HEAD, so a HEAD pin is stale the moment it is written (measured 2026-08-25: a Sol session STOPped on exactly that). Nothing on ops/OUTCOME_CARRYING_ARTIFACTS.json may be listed here. Each entry declares role: "delivery" (a document authored for this review; must itself carry the off-limits list) or "reference" (pre-existing bytes handed along; scanned for unmarked quarantined paths, but NOT required to carry governance text — requiring that would mean editing an approved record to satisfy a test). Guarded by tests/test_artifacts_under_review_are_frozen.py and tests/test_review_artifacts_are_outcome_clean.py

under_review.repin_incident: RE-PINNED d6e85102b662 -> ae104e889d36, and the reason is recorded rather than tidied away. Commit ae104e8 added one line to this file — DELIVERY_STATUS=ISSUED — while the file was registered and marked issued. The delta is that single line; no hash row, instruction or constraint in the packet changed. This is the THIRD instance today of the same class (round 4's TRANSPORT_STOP, then an unarmed register here, now an edit after arming), and the first two were caught by reasoning while this one was caught by the guard — six minutes later, at full-suite time. The ordering rule the qros-runtime guard states in prose (write the status BEFORE the hash is taken) was violated by the very backfill that introduced it.
